about: What makes renovation in Pechersk different

In the club residences of Pechersk and Lypky, renovation is approved with the management company, works follow the building schedule, and materials are delivered by the house rules. Historic buildings add old masonry walls, high ceilings and engineering that often has to be replaced completely.
Our office is at 44 Antonovycha St., next to Pechersk, so we reach sites in the centre quickly. Among our design projects for this kind of property is the 210 m² Linden Penthouse.
How much design and renovation cost

Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500), turnkey renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate), furnishing from $250 per m².
If CAS carries out the renovation to our design, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate. The exact sum comes from the estimate after the survey; the survey is paid, a phone consultation is free.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Pechersk cost?
Turnkey renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), design from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250 per m². The exact sum is fixed in the estimate after the survey.
Who handles approvals with the management company?
We do: we agree the works, schedule and material deliveries according to the house rules.
Do you renovate flats in old buildings?
Yes. In historic buildings we often replace the engineering completely and correct the geometry; this goes into the estimate after the inspection.
Can I order only the design?
Yes. But the risks are lowest when design, renovation and furniture are handled by one team.
12 months on works; photo reports every 1–2 weeks.
